title: Enforce Authorization Server-Side
description: Perform authorization checks on the server for every protected resource and operation.
implementation: Derive authorization decisions from the authenticated principal, requested operation, and target resource. Never rely solely on client-side controls.

title: Enforce Object-Level Authorization
description: Verify that the current principal is authorized to access the specific object identified by a request.
implementation: Combine object lookup and authorization checks so that an authenticated user cannot retrieve another user's resources merely by changing an identifier.

title: Use Parameterized Queries
description: Separate untrusted data from query structure when interacting with databases.
implementation: Use parameterized queries or safe ORM mechanisms. Avoid constructing database queries by concatenating untrusted input.

title: Harden Authentication and Sessions
description: Use strong authentication controls and correctly manage session lifecycle.
implementation: Use secure password handling, MFA where appropriate, secure session cookies, session expiration, and server-side invalidation.
